facts.fact: The INS yearbook 2020-2024 (edition 2025, validated by the INS quality committee on 30 April 2025) publishes tables sourced to the Ministry of Transport and Civil Aviation's own statistical yearbook; as_of is the edition year 2025 as no month is given, the figures cover 2020-2024.

note: Captured text (cut at the fetch cap, in chapter 4) names ministries as sources only for transport; the contents list health, education, trade and justice chapters but their sources are not in the capture; the notes say sources are given at the head of each chapter and that data come from INS collection or official administrative documents; no dated statement of regular publication.
